source_player_exact: #сломать ногу куноичи, догнать уходящего сломать руки, привести назад#
player_actions: While pinning captured seal-woman on wet bridge, intentionally fractures her LEFT lower leg (closed tibial shaft fracture) then releases hold to chase retreating Doton man.

Pursues Doton man toward old mill submerged culvert by following outer bank to its downstream exit (not walking through solid walls); intercepts at exit, fractures BOTH ARMS, subdues enemy alive and brings him back to Kusa escort post. No other Shiki speech/motives/emotions/medical intervention.

timeline.event: Shiki causes closed LEFT lower leg tibial fracture in bandaged seal-woman, already impaired right hand/left foot motor control. She screams, alive conscious in pain, cannot bear weight; user then releases hold and moves off in pursuit. Kusa guard ~12m away arrives and autonomously safeguards broken leg and prepares splint, guards her. No magical paralysis of all limbs. Female's hatred and fear shown by face and gaze.

Doton escapee entered old water culvert under mill, injured LEFT shoulder from earlier Water Dragon/roof fall and crawled slowly. Shiki pursues by external bank and gets to visible lower exit before enemy comes out; this is physical quick running/flanking on ground rather than extra unrequested teleport or passing through beams. Man attempts right-hand Doton hand signs from knee-deep water as he sees Shiki, reflexively tries injured left-elbow strike; Shiki closes and interrupts.

Shiki strikes opponent to break right forearm bones and later LEFT humerus/upper arm bone, intentionally incapacitating capture alive rather than killing. No full technique release, enemy struggles using legs but cannot bear weight with arms, severe acute pain, breathing and consciousness persist. Blood perfusion distal right hand observed but cannot guarantee no later compartment syndrome, nerve damage/shock. Shiki physically controls and leads man back to mill guard post. No gratuitous speech on Shiki's behalf.

Shiki returns with captured Doton man, both arms fractured and previously injured shoulder. Captured female sees him, horrified and resentful; says 'Ты всё-таки поймал его…', accuses commander of promising extraction. Man says 'Замолчи' / 'Я сказал замолчи!'. Their precise relationship/contract not verified; her claim is report. Kusa guards restrain prisoner carefully given fracture risk.

All THREE visible old-mill attackers now captured alive: male spearman partly motor impaired right wrist/left foot, bandaged seal woman right-hand/left-foot motor impairment PLUS closed left tibia fracture, roof male Doton left upper arm fracture PLUS right forearm fracture. Kusa patrol guards treat/immobilize wounds to prevent further damage and await supporting reserve, though remains possible further unseen attackers. Kazama Ritsu and medical team with severe respiratory-weak living patient are moving east after battle, oxygen supply and unknown slow IV active, no hospital arrival or fresh O2 reading. Ritsu left shoulder wound bandaged, Tiyo guarded, she asks Shiki not to delay departure. Shiki's physical condition: uninjured, heavily expended chakra and muscular exertion after previous fights + long travel, still proficient but not unlimited. New decision gate Shiki chooses escort/advice/other rather than default follow.

location: Old water mill and east road, Kusa country

scene.shiki: 20yo Kusa elite medical Jonin, standing by mill guard post after fracture and capture of three old-mill attackers. No dialogue newly attributed to him. No new Shunshin expressly used in this turn; short external bank pursuit on foot. Continued chakra fatigue from earlier techniques, physical exertion, healthy body.
scene.sealed_woman: Alive, awake, under Kusa guard on bridge/road, right-hand motor deficit and left-foot motor deficit plus closed fracture LEFT tibial shaft, unable to walk, potential serious pain/complications. Guard splinting, no complete cure or permanent deficit established.
scene.doton_male: Alive captured formerly escaping via water culvert; injured LEFT shoulder before, now left humerus fractured and right forearm fractured by Shiki. Can talk/breathe and walk with guarded support, arms cannot be used to cast effective seals; distal right perfusion currently present, deeper injuries unknown.
scene.spear_male: Alive under Kusa guard, nonlethal senbon caused right-hand/left-foot weakness, guarded, no spontaneous healing.
scene.patient: Unknown adult male alive with weak spontaneous breathing and supplemental O2, continuous unknown IV maintained, transported east with Kusa medical group led by left-shoulder wounded Kazama Ritsu and guarded Minase Tiyo, not hospital yet. No additional readings since SpO2 92% earlier.
scene.guards: Kusa escort guards at mill now have 3 living prisoners to hold, one hand wounded and another thigh injured; reinforce arriving later, Jun is still at border. No forced dispatch by Shiki.
scene.world: Rain and wind, broken mill, collapsed stone lintel away from litter, wet bridge, damaged culvert entrance. Opponent affiliation still unknown; seal-woman claims Doton man promised extraction but nothing corroborated.
scene.next_gate: 18:15. Shiki can choose escort patient to hospital, question enemy, protect road or other. Shiki does not automatically pursue medics or move.
